### FY17–FY19 — Paradip Commissioning, Throughput Expansion & Excise Structuring
- **FY17 (`PAT ₹19,106.40 Cr`):** Paradip Refinery (`15.00 MMTPA`) stabilized, pushing corporate throughput to `65.19 MMT` and GRM to `$10.22/bbl`. Under Ind-AS Schedule III, revenue is disclosed Gross (`₹4,45,373 Cr`) inclusive of Central Excise Duty (`₹85,500 Cr`), yielding Net Revenue of `₹3,59,873 Cr`.
- **FY18 (`PAT ₹21,346.00 Cr`):** Highest utilization across coastal and inland refineries lifted throughput to `69.00 MMT` and Net Revenue `+17.9% YoY` to `₹4,24,213 Cr`. Board approved a `1:1` bonus issue.
- **FY19 (`PAT ₹16,894.15 Cr`):** Higher Brent crude lifted Gross Revenue `+19.6% YoY` to `₹6,05,924 Cr`, while narrowing light-distillate cracks compressed GRM from `$8.49` to `$5.41/bbl`. Working capital absorption and share buyback lifted Total Debt to `₹86,359 Cr`.

note_ref: FY20 — COVID-19 Crude Crash & `₹11,305 Cr` Exceptional Inventory Write-Down
title: 2. Year-by-Year Annual Report MD&A Deep-Dive — FY20 — COVID-19 Crude Crash & `₹11,305 Cr` Exceptional Inventory Write-Down
content:
### FY20 — COVID-19 Crude Crash & `₹11,305 Cr` Exceptional Inventory Write-Down
- **What Happened:** Brent crude collapsed below `$23/bbl` in March 2020 during nationwide lockdown, compelling an NRV (Net Realizable Value) write-down on crude and finished product inventories, including **`₹11,305.00 Cr` classified as Exceptional Loss** (Schedule III Line VI). Reported GRM fell to **`$0.08/bbl`**, even though underlying **Core GRM stood resilient at `$4.10/bbl`**.
- **Accounting & Tax Shifts:** IOCL adopted **Ind AS 116 (Leases)** (`₹6,180 Cr` non-current lease liabilities) and transitioned to Section **115BAA** (`25.168%` corporate tax rate), enabling `₹1,313.23 Cr` positive Standalone PAT despite severe inventory shock.

However, retail petrol/diesel pump prices remained frozen despite `$95+/bbl` Brent, creating sharp Marketing Division margin compression.

Shares doubled-plus via a `1:2` bonus issue (`1,412.1238 Cr` shares).

## 1. Refinery Fuel & Loss and Energy Efficiency (`L01`) — `₹940 Cr/yr` EBITDA Uplift
- **Financial Trigger:** Combined FY26 Fuel & Loss stands at **`8.20%`** across `75.451 MMT` crude processed, led by legacy inland/North-East refineries (`Digboi 11.4%`, `Guwahati 10.6%`, `Bongaigaon 9.2%`, `Barauni 8.9%`) vs coastal `Paradip 7.6%` and `Panipat 7.8%`.

title: Gross vs Net Revenue & Excise Duty Pass-Through (Ind AS 115 / Note 28)
content: Under Ind AS 115, IOCL presents Revenue from Operations Gross of Central Excise Duty (Rs 8,86,224.41 Cr in FY26) and reports Central Excise Duty (Rs 1,02,066.54 Cr in FY26) as a separate line item in Expenses, leaving Net Revenue of Rs 7,84,157.87 Cr. Excise peaked at Rs 1,36,832.00 Cr (26.6% of turnover) in FY21 during pandemic duty hikes before normalizing after November 2021 and May 2022 central duty cuts.

note_ref: Schedule III Line VI: Exceptional NRV Write-Down & Tax Regime Shift
title: FY20 COVID-19 Crude Crash (Rs 11,305 Cr Exceptional Loss), Core GRM & Ind AS 116
content: In Q4 FY20, global lockdowns collapsed Brent crude below $23/bbl, forcing an exceptional inventory Net Realizable Value (NRV) write-down of Rs 11,305.00 Cr on Schedule III Line VI. Reported GRM sank to $0.08/bbl despite Core GRM holding at $4.10/bbl. Simultaneously, IOCL adopted Ind AS 116 Leases (bringing time-charter tankers and retail outlet leases onto the balance sheet) and shifted to the 25.168% Section 115BAA corporate tax regime.
source_citation: IOCL Annual Report Notes (Schedule III Line VI: Exceptional NRV Write-Down & Tax Regime Shift)

title: FY23 Retail MS/HSD Price Freeze, Rs 10,801 Cr GoI LPG Grant & 1:2 Bonus Shares
content: In FY23, despite achieving all-time high Gross Revenue (Rs 9,34,953.00 Cr) and record Reported GRM ($19.52/bbl), unrecovered retail petrol/diesel margins compressed Marketing profitability. GoI sanctioned a one-time Rs 10,801.00 Cr LPG under-recovery grant recognized in operating revenue, protecting Rs 8,241.82 Cr Standalone PAT, while Total Debt expanded to Rs 1,32,495 Cr. IOCL also issued 1:2 bonus equity shares expanding paid-up shares to 1,412.1238 Cr.
source_citation: IOCL Annual Report Notes (Note 28 / LPG Subsidy & Price Freeze)

note_ref: Notes 24-25: Indane LPG Consumer Security Deposits
title: Structural Negative Working Capital: Indane LPG Security Deposits Float
content: IOCL holds over Rs 34,000 Cr of Indane LPG consumer cylinder and regulator security deposits inside Other Current Liabilities (Notes 24-25), alongside ~Rs 46,000+ Cr of crude trade payables (15-45 day suppliers credit). Combined with ultra-low 6.1-day DSO on retail fuel sales, this creates structural negative Net Working Capital (~-Rs 38,000 Cr in FY26) that partially funds Capex without interest cost.
source_citation: IOCL Annual Report Notes (Notes 24-25: Indane LPG Consumer Security Deposits)

title: NSE:IOC Share Count (1,412.1238 Cr), Debt, WACC (9.25%) & GRM Sensitivity
